title: RegisterSession then UnregisterSession
purpose: Demonstrate a stateful session lifecycle by registering a session and then sending a syntactically valid UnregisterSession using a nonzero session handle.
expected_behavior: The parser should accept both messages as complete encapsulation commands and dispatch a session registration path followed by an unregister path.
constraints_preserved: RegisterSession uses command 0x0065 with length 4 and a 4-byte body.
Both messages preserve the 24-byte header layout.
Session handle in the unregister request is a 4-byte little-endian nonzero value.
Status and options are zero in both requests.
issue_safety_notes: This is a normal valid lifecycle sequence and does not assert semantic success of the chosen session handle beyond structural validity.
